x: Barry Ingarfield was expected to take the Horwood Cup without much trouble but he pushed away from the start to win by some three minutes from John Bromley with Manx man John Wilkinson in third place.
Other names to go on to better things were John Wilkinson and J.M.K Finley in the sprints, Angus Scott in the 880 and Chris Brasher in the 3 miles.
Several talented newcomers were now on the scene, such as Ken Jones, Willie Jack, John Wilkinson and Nick Stacey but Bailey still remained King.
